automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.rule: Only sources with a concrete visible publication or update date inside the preceding 48 hours were eligible.

federation.boundary: Broad companies, models, products, developer tools, agentic frameworks, MCP servers, and general techniques are upstream-owned. This collector retains only local AI-assisted-development practice implications.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Microsoft reports that its Smart DRI Agent consolidates incident information, telemetry, troubleshooting guidance, and operational updates; it is used by more than 40 teams and has produced more than 7,800 AI-assisted interactions and nearly 6,000 proactive incident notifications.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: For incident-facing development agents, keep operational context, troubleshooting evidence, and escalation outputs in one inspectable workspace, then measure adoption with operational outcomes such as notifications handled and engineering time recovered. Route the vendor implementation itself upstream.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Candidate ingest lens: application-patterns/agent-harness-components.md and adoption-and-operating-model; verify which reported metrics represent causal savings before durable synthesis.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenHands announced support for a multimodal model in its software-engineering agents, describing always-on agents that can see, reason, and act across specialized engineering workflows.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Treat a move from text-only to multimodal agent inputs as a harness-boundary change: declare allowed visual sources, capture provenance for screenshots or UI observations, and extend review and privacy checks to the added input modality. Route framework and model coverage upstream.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Candidate ingest lens: application-patterns/browser-agent-runtime-boundaries.md and governance-and-risk; seek implementation documentation before adding a durable rule.
